schema_excerpts.airbnbSettingsGet:
airbnbSettingsGet:
      allOf:
      - properties:
          channel:
              type: string
              example: airbnb
          properties:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                airbnbUserId:
                  type: string
                  nullable: true
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/airbnbSettingsPost'
      - properties:
          properties:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                id: 
                  type: integer
                roomTypes:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      enabled:
                        type: boolean
                      airbnbListingId:
                        type: number
                      connect:
                        type: string
                        enum:
                          - "inventory"
                          - "limited"
                          - "full"

schema_excerpts.channels_settings_path:
/channels/settings:
    get:
      summary: Alpha - Get channel settings
      tags:
        - Channels - settings
      security:
        - token: []
        - organization: []
      parameters:
          - name: propertyId
            in: query
            required: true
            schema:
              type: string
          - name: roomId
            in: query
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                type: integer
          - name: channel
            in: query
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
                enum:
                  #- "vrbo"
                  #- "nuki"
                  - "iCalExport"
                  - "iCalImport"
                  - "airbnb"
                  - "vrbo"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          headers:
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit'
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn'
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining'
            X-RequestCost:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-RequestCost'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SuccessfulApiResponse'
                  - properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                        example: "channelSetting"
                      pages:
                        $ref: '#/components/schemas/pages'
                      data:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          anyOf:
                            
                            #- $ref: '#/components/schemas/nukiSettingsGet'
                            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/airbnbSettingsGet'
                            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/vrboSettingsGet'
                            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iCalExportSettingsGet'
                            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iCalImportSettingsGet'
        '400':
          description: Unsuccesful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnsuccessfulApiResponse'
    post:
      summary: Alpha - Set channel settings
      tags:
        - Channels - settings
      security:
        - token: []
        - organization: []
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/vrboSettingsPost'
                  #- $ref: '#/components/schemas/nukiSettingsPost'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/airbnbSettingsPost'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iCalExportSettingsPost'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iCalImportSettingsPost'
            examples:
              channelSetting:
                summary: Change a channel setting
                value: [
                        {
                          "channel": "airbnb",
                          "properties": [
                            {
                              "id": 12345678,
                              "multiplier": 1.3,
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                      ]
              channelRoomSetting:
                summary: Change a channel's room settings
                value: [
                        {
                          "channel": "vrbo",
                          "properties": [{
                            "id": 12345678,
                            "roomTypes": [
                              {
                                "id": 9012345,
                                "7DayDiscountPercent": 35,
                                "cancellationPolicy": "noRefund"
                              }
                            ]
                          }]
                        }
                      ]
                      
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Successful operation
          headers:
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit'
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn'
            X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining'
            X-RequestCost:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/X-RequestCost'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  allOf:
                    - type: object
                    - $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiplePostResponse'
